setup.desc_short: Set up a channel for counting.
setup.desc_long: Set up a channel for counting. Make sure the @everyone role can use external emojis within that channel.

disable.desc_long: Disable counting in a channel. Channel return to a normal text channel.

profile.desc_long: View your profile to see how many coins you have and how many fonts you own. You can also see your statistics.

shop.desc_short: View items available for purchase in the store.
shop.desc_long: View the items available for purchase in the store using your coins.

purchase.desc_long: Purchase fonts from the store to replace Discord's normal text.

equip.desc_short: Equip a font from your collection.
equip.desc_long: Equip a font from your collection to replace Discord's normal text.

vote.desc_short: Links to vote for Counter in exchange for rewards!
vote.desc_long: Get the links to vote for Counter on bot listing websites in exchange for rewards!

botinfo.desc_short: View the bot's statistics and system information.
botinfo.desc_long: View the bot's statistics and system information.

channel.desc_short: View all guild's counting channels and their settings.
channel.desc_long: View all guild's counting channels and their settings.

leaderboard.desc_short: View the top users by scope and type.
leaderboard.desc_long: View the top users globaly or in your guild and by total counted or coins owned.

deletedata.desc_short: Delete your user data, or the current guild data.
deletedata.desc_long: Delete your user data, or the current guild data. This action is irreversible!.
